newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Blochs gets new controlling shareholders.
newsitem.headline: Blochs gets new controlling shareholders.

text.p: South African supermarket outfit Bloch Ltd said on Wednesday that a consortium will buy some 12.49 million shares or 67 percent of its share capital resulting in a change of control at Blochs.
It said that the consortium would purchase the stake from Bloch Holdings Channel Islands Ltd, as well as two private persons and their associates at 105 cents per Blochs share, to be paid in cash.
The deal takes effect on Wednesday.

Blochs said that of the shares bought, 2.89 million will immediately be renounced to various independent investors, resulting in the consortium ending up with 9.6 million Bloch shares, representing a 51.3 percent stake.
An offer would be made to minority shareholders.
